description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language families. The horizontal axis represents the number of tasks, ranging from 0 to 80, while the vertical axis lists the language families. The bars are color-coded and arranged in descending order from the highest to the lowest number of tasks. The IE-Slavic language family has the highest number of tasks, close to 80, followed by IE-Romance with around 70 tasks. IE-Germanic has approximately 50 tasks, and IE-Baltic has around 20 tasks. The remaining language families, including IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, have fewer tasks, with Basque having the least, close to 0 tasks. The chart does not provide specific values for each language family, but the approximate values are indicated by the length of the bars.
